title: Implement Authentication and Authorization
problem_statement: Platform lacks authentication mechanisms, exposing agent endpoints to unauthorized access
risk_if_unaddressed: Security breach, unauthorized agent access, data exposure
suggested_approach: Implement JWT-based authentication with role-based access control for agent endpoints

provenance.evidence: No authentication patterns detected in endpoint analysis

title: Add Comprehensive Test Suite
problem_statement: No test files detected, indicating lack of automated testing and quality assurance
risk_if_unaddressed: Production bugs, regression issues, maintenance difficulties
suggested_approach: Implement unit tests for all agents, integration tests for web endpoints, and end-to-end workflow tests

provenance.evidence: No test files found in 264 scanned files

title: Refactor High-Complexity Agents
problem_statement: Analyst agent has 25 imports suggesting high complexity and tight coupling
risk_if_unaddressed: Maintenance difficulties, testing challenges, reduced modularity
suggested_approach: Break down analyst agent into smaller, focused components with clear interfaces
success_criteria: Analyst agent import count reduced to <15

title: Implement Production Logging and Monitoring
problem_statement: No standardized logging or monitoring patterns detected for production deployment
risk_if_unaddressed: Difficult troubleshooting, no visibility into production issues
suggested_approach: Implement structured logging with correlation IDs and integrate monitoring for agent performance
success_criteria: Structured logging implemented across all components

title: Secure Team Data Storage
problem_statement: Team data stored in plain JSON files without encryption or access controls
risk_if_unaddressed: Data exposure, unauthorized access to sensitive team information
suggested_approach: Implement encrypted storage for team data with proper access controls

provenance.evidence: Plain text JSON storage for team data
